answer: Nobody is waved through free: an examination charge of £44, charged again each time a name fails is the price, and the island never covers it twice. Every entry must show Authorised brickmaker trade certificate from the brickmakers craft council before the ledger opens, because a trade certificate brickmakers issue after kiln audits. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The clerk notes tundra. anchor is written on the receipt.
